name: Finding and preparing information for the Mind
vision_statement: The information a request needs is found and prepared before the Mind asks for it, from the system's own cards, its files and what comes to mind unasked.
opportunities: How cards are built from files, how the right ones are picked for a request and what comes to mind unasked can each be improved on one measure without changing the Mind.
solution_coherence: This part finds and prepares information before it is asked for. Cards From Files builds cards from the files of the system. Context Retriever picks the cards and file units that bear on the request. Intuition offers what occurs to the system unasked.
